# Load results

* Predictions generated in `genom_pred_btw-BP.Rmd`.

```{r load_results}
#p2f <- here("output","genom-pred_6-scenarios-BPs_pred-ab.tsv")
meth <- "GBLUP"
# nscenarios <- 6
suf <- ""

# p2f <- here("output",paste0("genom-pred_",nscenarios,"-scenarios_",
#                             meth,"-method_BPs_pred-ab.tsv"))

p2f <- here("output",paste0("genom-pred_all-scenarios_",meth,
                            "-method_BPs_pred-ab",suf,".tsv"))
file.mtime(p2f)
all.res <- fread(p2f)
table(all.res$scenario)
head(all.res)
all.res <- all.res |> filter(!(scenario %in% "wBP" & trainSetBP %in% "NUR"))
## order the traits: first agro, FHB and wheat qual
unique(all.res$trait)
trait.lvl <- c("DIS","VSK","DON")
stopifnot(all(all.res$trait %in% trait.lvl))
all.res$trait <- factor(all.res$trait, levels=trait.lvl)
traits <- levels(all.res$trait)
```

```{r}
gtsummary::tbl_summary(
  data=all.res |> filter(!is.na(corP)),
  by = scenario,
  include = c(scenario, corP),
  type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
  statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})", "{min}, {max}")
  
)
```



# Results by scenario

Conceive one color scale to apply to all the plots:

## wBP

```{r wBP-plot-res}
BP.lvls <- c("NUR","MN","ND","SD","MT") 
p.wBP <- all.res |>
  filter(scenario %in% "wBP") |> #, !trainSetBP %in% "NUR") |> 
  group_by(trait, trainSetBP,nb.genos.TS, nb.genos.VS) |> 
  summarize(corP=mean(corP),CI=mean(CI),.groups="drop") |> 
  mutate(trainSetBP=factor(trainSetBP, levels=BP.lvls),
         trait=factor(trait, levels=traits),
         lab=paste0(round(corP,2),"\n(",round(CI,4),")"),
         lab1=paste0(round(corP,2)),
         lab2=paste0("(",round(CI,3),")")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=trainSetBP, y=trait,fill=corP, label=lab))+
  geom_tile(show.legend=F, color="white", linewidth=0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("red","orange","white","yellow","forestgreen"),
    limits=c(-1,1),na.value = "grey80")+
  labs(x="Validation Set",y="Trait", title="Scenario: within breeding program")+
  geom_label(mapping=aes(label=lab1),fill="white",linewidth=0,
                   alpha=0.5, size=3.7)+
  geom_label_repel(mapping=aes(label=lab2),nudge_y = -0.1,fill=NA,
                            linewidth=0, size=3)+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(size=rel(1.1)))
plot(p.wBP)
ggsave(here("output","figures",paste0("GP-heatmap_wBP-corP.png")),
       width=6,height=6,scale=0.8)
```


Run some statistics
```{r}
## mean predictive ability by trait
all.res |> filter(scenario %in% "wBP") |>
  group_by(trait) |>
  summarize(mean_corP=round(mean(corP),3),
            sd_corP=round(sd(corP),3),
            nb.genos.TS=mean(nb.genos.TS),
            nb.genos.VS=mean(nb.genos.VS),
            .groups="drop") |>
  # arrange(desc(mean_corP)) |> 
  print_table()

## average predictive ability by breeding program
all.res |> filter(scenario %in% "wBP") |>
  group_by(trainSetBP) |>
  summarize(mean_corP=round(mean(corP),3),
            sd_corP=round(sd(corP),3),,
            nb.genos.TS=mean(nb.genos.TS),
            nb.genos.VS=mean(nb.genos.VS),
            .groups="drop") |>

```

Compare with the wBP scenario

```{r}
comp.resamp <- all.res |> filter(scenario %in% c("wBP", "wBP.resamp"),
                                 trainSetBP %in% c("MN","ND","SD")) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols=c(trait,trainSetBP),
              names_from=scenario, values_from=c(corP))
cor(comp.resamp$wBP, comp.resamp$wBP.resamp)
comp.resamp <- comp.resamp |> mutate(diff=wBP-wBP.resamp)
comp.resamp
colMeans(comp.resamp[,c("wBP","wBP.resamp","diff")])
comp.resamp |> summarize(mean_diff=mean(diff), .by=trainSetBP)

```

## acBP

```{r acBP_res}
## full results
p.acBP <- all.res |> 
  filter(scenario %in% "acBP", !trainSetBP %in% "NUR", !validSetBP %in% "NUR") |>
  mutate(trainSetBP=factor(trainSetBP, levels=BP.lvls),
         validSetBP=factor(validSetBP, levels=BP.lvls),
         trait=factor(trait, levels=traits),
         lab=paste0(round(corP,2),"\n(",round(CI,4),")"),
         lab1=paste0(round(corP,2)),
         lab2=paste0("(",round(CI,3),")")) |> 
  filter(!trainSetBP %in% "NUR" & !validSetBP %in% "NUR") |> 
  droplevels() |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=trainSetBP, x=validSetBP,fill=corP))+
  facet_wrap(~trait, nrow=1)+
  geom_tile(show.legend=F, color="white", linewidth=0.8) +
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  ## add lines around the tiles
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(1.5,3.5,by=1), color="grey85", linewidth=0.1)+

  geom_label_repel(mapping=aes(label=lab2), fill=NA,nudge_y = -0.25,linewidth=0,size=2,
                   force_pull = 10,force=0, min.segment.length = 5)+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("red","orange","white","yellow","forestgreen"),
    limits=c(-1,1),na.value = "grey80")+
  theme(strip.background=element_rect(color="grey85"), 
        legend.position="none",
        panel.border = element_rect(color="grey85"),
        panel.grid=element_blank())
```

- What's the pair of TS/VS that gives the best predictive ability on average?
```{r}
acBP <- all.res |> filter(scenario %in% "acBP",!validSetBP %in% "NUR",!trainSetBP %in% "NUR") 
summary(acBP$corP)
## best pair of training/validation sets
acBP |>  group_by(trainSetBP, validSetBP) |>
  summarize(mean_corP=round(mean(corP),3), .groups="drop") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_corP)) |> 
  print_table()
## best validation set
acBP |> group_by(validSetBP) |>
  summarize(mean_corP=round(mean(corP),3), .groups="drop") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_corP)) |> 
  print_table()
## best training set
acBP |> group_by(trainSetBP) |>
  summarize(mean_corP=round(mean(corP),3), .groups="drop") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_corP)) |> 
  print_table()
```


- What is the mean and variance of predictive ability per trait?
```{r}
acBP |>  group_by(trait) |>
  summarize(mean_corP=round(mean(corP),3),
            sd_corP=round(sd(corP),3),
            .groups="drop") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_corP)) |> 
  print_table()
```

### Average predictive ability across traits for main scenarios

Average predictive ability over the traits. 

Format
```{r}
dat2plot <- all.res |> 
  filter(nb.genos.VS != 0 | is.na(nb.genos.VS),
         !validSetBP %in% "NUR",
         scenario %in% c("wBP","acAllBP","nursBP")) |> 
  bind_rows(filter(all.res, scenario %in% "acBP", trainSetBP %in% "NUR")) |> 
  group_by(scenario, validSetBP) |>
  summarize(mean_corP=mean(corP),
            sd_corP=sd(corP),
            .groups="drop") 
dat2plot$scenario <- recode(dat2plot$scenario, "wBP"="within BP",
                            "acAllBP"="across all BP", "nursBP"="NUR-BP","acBP"="NUR-all")

## for the acBP, take the best average BP
acBP_best <- all.res |> 
  filter(scenario %in% "acBP", !trainSetBP %in% "NUR", !validSetBP %in% "NUR") |>
  group_by(trainSetBP, validSetBP) |>
  summarize(mean_corP=round(mean(corP),3),
            sd_corP=round(sd(corP),3),
            .groups="drop") |> 
  slice_max(mean_corP, n=1, by=validSetBP) |> 
  mutate(scenario="acBP best")
print_table(acBP_best)
dat2plot <- bind_rows(dat2plot, acBP_best) |> 
  mutate(scenario=factor(scenario, levels=c("within BP","across all BP","acBP best","NUR-all","NUR-BP")))
```

Unexpectedly, MT is the best training set for ND.


Plot
```{r}
#  add CI
cols <- c("within BP"="grey60", "across all BP"="brown1", "NUR-BP"="gold2", 
          "NUR-all"="dodgerblue", "acBP best"="forestgreen")
pos <- position_dodge(width=0.4)

ggplot(dat2plot,aes(y=mean_corP, x=validSetBP, ymin=mean_corP-sd_corP, ymax=mean_corP+sd_corP,
                    color=scenario,shape=scenario, group=scenario))+
  geom_point(size=3.5,position=pos)+
  geom_errorbar(linewidth=0.5, width=0.25, position =pos)+
  labs(y="Mean Pearson correlation",x="Validation set")+
```

## Compare use of nursery 

### Nursery, subset or not by BP

```{r}
dat2plot <- bind_rows(
  all.res |> filter(trainSetBP %in% "NUR",scenario %in% c("acBP")),
  all.res |> filter(scenario %in% c("nursBP"))) |> 
  mutate(scenario=factor(scenario, levels=c("nursBP","acBP"))) 


tapply(dat2plot$corP, dat2plot$scenario, summary)
dat.wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(dat2plot, id_cols=c("trait","validSetBP"), 
                               names_from = scenario, values_from = corP)

  scale_fill_manual(values=c("acBP"="dodgerblue","nursBP"="gold2"),
                    labels=c("acBP"="NUR-all","nursBP"="NUR-BP"),
                    name="Prediction scenario")+ 
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+ 
  geom_col(position=position_dodge(0.9))+

       width=6,height=7,scale=0.8)
```

```{r}
## Map H2 of the validation set
```

```{r}
table(genRel$scenario)

  summarize(nb.genos.TS=mean(nb.genos.TS),
```

Combine predictive ability and genetic relatedness

```{r}
table(all.res$scenario)
all.res$trainSetBP[all.res$scenario %in% "acAllBP"] <- "AllOtherBP"
idx <- which(all.res$scenario %in% "nursBP")
all.res$trainSetBP[idx] <- paste0("NUR-", all.res$validSetBP[idx])
pa.rel <- all.res |>
  filter(!validSetBP %in% "NUR",
         !scenario %in% c("acTPE","wTPE")) |> 
  dplyr::select(trait, scenario, trainSetBP,validSetBP, corP, CI) |>
  left_join(genRel, by=c("trait","scenario","trainSetBP","validSetBP")) |>
  filter(!is.na(Roger_distance)) 
#filter(quantiles %in% "90%") 
unique(pa.rel$scenario)
pa.rel$scenario[pa.rel$scenario %in% "acBP" & pa.rel$trainSetBP %in% "NUR"] <- "NUR-all"
pa.rel$scenario <- recode(pa.rel$scenario, "wBP"="within BP",
                          "acAllBP"="across all BP", "nursBP"="NUR-BP","acBP"="NUR-all")
scenarios <- c("within BP","across all BP","NUR-BP","NUR-all")
```

```{r}
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(0:5), name="Prediction scenario")+
  guides(shape=guide_legend(nrow=2))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey70",linewidth=0.8)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, color="black", linetype="dotted", linewidth=0.2)+
  geom_point(stroke=1.3, size=2.2, aes(color=validSetBP, shape=scenario))+
  geom_errorbar(width=0, linewidth=0.1)+
  geom_rug(sides="bl", mapping=aes(color=validSetBP), linewidth=0.3)+
  #ggpmisc::stat_correlation(method="pearson", label.x = "left", label.y="top")+
  stat_cor(cor.coef.name = "R", label.x.npc = 0.7)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols.bp, name="Validation set")+
  labs(y="Predictive ability", x="minimum Roger's distance")+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title.position="top", legend.byrow=T)
ggsave(here("output","figures","GP-PA_vs-genRel_min_Roger-distance.png"),
       width=7,height=5,scale=0.9)
```

## Combine variables in one tables

```{r}
genRel <- genRel |> mutate(scenario=recode(scenario, "acBP_sinceDate"="acBP-NUR-sinceDate")) 
table(genRel$scenario)
dat.mod <- all.res |> 
  dplyr::select(-cohort.valid,-slopes, -nb.genos.TS, -nb.genos.VS) |> 
  filter(scenario %in% c("wBP","wBP.resamp","acBP","acBP-NUR-sinceDate","acAllBP","nursBP")) |> 
  left_join(dat$fitSummary[c("BP","trait","H2.Cullis","varG")], by=c("trainSetBP"="BP","trait")) |>
  rename(H2Train=H2.Cullis, varGTrain=varG) |>
  left_join(dat$fitSummary[c("BP","trait","H2.Cullis","varG")], by=c("validSetBP"="BP","trait")) |>
  rename(H2Valid=H2.Cullis, varGValid=varG) |>
  left_join(genRel, #|> select(-nb.genos.TS,-nb.genos.VS),
            by=c("trait","scenario","trainSetBP","validSetBP")) |>
  filter(!scenario %in% c("acAllBP")) |> 
  mutate(across(H2Train:min_Roger_distance, scale)) |> 
  mutate(scenario=ifelse(scenario %in% "acBP" & trainSetBP %in% "NUR", "acBP-NUR", scenario)) 


##  add H2 back to nursBP
for(i in which(dat.mod$scenario %in% c("nursBP","acBP-NUR-sinceDate"))){
  dat.mod$H2Train[i] <- dat$fitSummary$H2.Cullis[dat$fitSummary$BP %in% "NUR" &
                                                   dat$fitSummary$trait %in% dat.mod$trait[i]]
  dat.mod$varGTrain[i] <- dat$fitSummary$varG[dat$fitSummary$BP %in% "NUR" &
                                                   dat$fitSummary$trait %in% dat.mod$trait[i]]
}

cor(dat.mod$Roger_distance, dat.mod$min_Roger_distance)
```




## Mixed model

### Fit all variables

All variables, missing data excluded

```{r}
dat.mod.noRowsNa <- dat.mod |> metan::remove_rows_na() |> as.data.frame() 

model_noRowsNa <- lme4::lmer(corP ~ nb.genos.TS + nb.genos.VS + Roger_distance + min_Roger_distance +
                               H2Valid+varGValid+
                               (1|trait) + 
                               (1|scenario) + 
                               (1|trainSetBP) +
                               (1|validSetBP),
                         data=dat.mod.noRowsNa,REML = FALSE)
model_noRowsNa <- update(model_noRowsNa, na.action = na.fail)
eval_global_noRowsNa <- MuMIn::dredge(model_noRowsNa, rank = "AICc")
head(eval_global_noRowsNa)
# Extract top model and refit with REML = TRUE for final estimates
top_global_ml_noRowsNa <- get.models(eval_global_noRowsNa, subset = 1)[[1]]
mod.mm <- update(top_global_ml_noRowsNa, REML = TRUE)
summary(mod.mm)
summary(model.avg(eval_global_noRowsNa, subset = delta < 2))

```


Missing observations, all variables. Most signif fixed variables: min_Roger_distance + Roger_distance + varGValid 

corP ~ min_Roger_distance + varGValid +  (1 | scenario) +(1 | trainSetBP) 

Discard trait and validSetBP as random effects, as they have no explained variance.


### Refit selected model

```{r}
dat.mod.noRowsNa <- dat.mod |> 
  select(trait, scenario, trainSetBP, validSetBP,corP, min_Roger_distance, varGValid) |> 
  metan::remove_rows_na()
model_final <- lme4::lmer(formula=corP ~ min_Roger_distance + varGValid + (1|scenario) + (1|trait),
                         data=dat.mod.noRowsNa,REML = FALSE)

summary(model_final)
dat.fit <- broom::augment_columns(model_final, dat.mod.noRowsNa)
```


### Plot genetic distance effect

```{r}
table(dat.fit$scenario)
dat.fit$scenario <- recode(dat.fit$scenario, "wBP"="within BP","wBP.resamp"="within BP resamp",
                          "nursBP"="NUR-BP","acBP-NUR"="NUR-all","acBP"="across BP",
                          "acBP-NUR-sinceDate"="NUR-since")
scenarios <- c("within BP","within BP resamp","NUR-BP","NUR-all","across BP","NUR-since")

## with min Roger distance
pos <- position_jitter(width=0.1, height=0,seed=454)
dat.fit |> filter(scenario %in% scenarios, !validSetBP %in% "NUR") |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=.fitted, x=min_Roger_distance, ymin=.fitted - 1.96 * .se.fit, 
             ymax=.fitted + 1.96 * .se.fit, color=validSetBP))+
  #facet_wrap(~trait)+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(0:5), name="Prediction scenario")+
  guides(shape=guide_legend(nrow=2),
         color=guide_legend(nrow=2))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey70",linewidth=0.8)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, color="black", linetype="dotted", linewidth=0.2)+
  geom_point(stroke=1.3, size=2.2, aes(color=validSetBP, shape=scenario))+
  geom_errorbar(width=0, linewidth=0.3)+
  geom_rug(sides="bl", mapping=aes(color=validSetBP), linewidth=0.3)+
  #ggpmisc::stat_correlation(method="pearson", label.x = "left", label.y="top")+
  stat_cor(cor.coef.name = "R", label.x.npc = 0.7, color="black")+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols.bp, name="Validation set")+
  labs(y="Predictive ability", x="minimum Roger's distance")+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
```
